Inset grouped list, iOS 27.0 simulator (iPhone 18 Pro, 402 x 874 pt), 2026-10-05.
Probe scene `list` (tool/ios_reference/Sources/Lists.swift), PROBE_DARK=0 / 1.
list-tree-<appearance>.txt: resolved background configurations (normal,
highlighted, selected), system colors, list content configuration paddings,
then the window's view tree: class, frame in window points, alpha, corner
radius, masked corners, resolved background / text / tint colors, fonts.
